source: Original dressing modules for the chamber. Room kit and room shell were not modified.
coordinate_system: Metres, Z up, detailed face -Y. Same FBX axis setup as the room kit.

assets.name: SM_DressPanel
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Back sits on +Y. Recess faces -Y.
assets.placement: Tile on the interior face of the shell bays. Vary yaw only to face the room. Alternate with SM_DressPanelAlt.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressPanelAlt
assets.origin: Same module as the first panel, rib and seam shifted.
assets.placement: Pair with SM_DressPanel so a wall is not one repeated stamp.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressPanelNarrow
assets.origin: 1.20 m wide, same depth and height.
assets.placement: Close a bay that the 2.40 m panel does not fill.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressPanelTall
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Two stacked recesses. Faces -Y.
assets.placement: Far wall and the taller side bays. One or two per cluster, not a full grid of identical tall panels.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressRib
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Projects toward -Y.
assets.placement: Vertical cover between panels. Thinner than SM_RoomPilaster. Do not replace the pilaster.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressRepairPlate
assets.origin: Bottom at Z=0. Face -Y.
assets.placement: One bolted patch per service cluster. Not a row.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressWallSpall
assets.origin: Bottom at Z=0. Broken face -Y.
assets.placement: A few bites on the lower wall. This is wall damage, not a floor debris card.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressConduitStraight
assets.origin: Mount at Z=0. Long axis X. 2 m.
assets.placement: Right wall and short jumps on the left. Smaller than SM_RoomPipeRack. Do not replace that rack.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressConduitElbow
assets.origin: Corner near the origin. Turn goes toward -Y.
assets.placement: Ends of a conduit run. Keep the turn outside the walk ring.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressConduitTee
assets.origin: Branch leaves toward -Y.
assets.placement: One or two where a run splits. No valve.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressJunctionBox
assets.origin: Back on +Y. Cover faces -Y.
assets.placement: Where conduits meet. Right wall mostly. The down stub may hang below the origin.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressCableLoop
assets.origin: Clamps near Z=0.55. The loop sags toward -Y.
assets.placement: One short loop in a cluster, as the art direction describes. Not a hanging mass over the fight.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressCableDrop
assets.origin: Top clip at Z=1.45. Bundle hangs to the floor.
assets.placement: From the cable tray down to a junction box. Right wall.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressPipeElbow
assets.origin: Vertical leg on Z, horizontal leg toward +X. No wheel.
assets.placement: Turn at the end of a left-wall pipe run. The rack already has its valve. Do not add one.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressFlangeJoint
assets.origin: Pipe along X at Z=0.10.
assets.placement: Visible joint in a pipe run. Bolted flanges, muted rust.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressPipeHanger
assets.origin: Plate at the top. Clevis hangs below Z=0.
assets.placement: Under a left-wall run, between the larger saddles.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressBreaker
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Door ajar toward -Y.
assets.placement: Right wall only. Smaller than SM_RoomServiceCabinet. Door stays dark. No glowing panel.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressGangBox
assets.origin: Back on +Y.
assets.placement: Small blank covers beside the breaker. Right wall.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressBundle
assets.origin: Long axis X, on the floor line.
assets.placement: Along the right-wall foot. Not a second cable spool.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressThreshold
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Long axis X. Nose toward -Y.
assets.placement: At the bulkhead sill. One plate. Not a ramp into a hall.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressAnchor
assets.origin: Floor Z=0.
assets.placement: A few floor anchors along the far utility strip and wall foot.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressDrainBox
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Square local drain.
assets.placement: Perimeter only, beside the gutter. Not a substitute for SM_RoomFloorGrate and not a stripe.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressKicker
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. Long axis X.
assets.placement: Short footing blocks along the cutaway and the far strip. Low. Not a wall.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressLouver
assets.origin: Bottom at Z=0. Slats face -Y.
assets.placement: Small wall vent. The big fan remains SM_RoomVentFan. One or two louvers, not a row.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressHatch
assets.origin: Bottom at Z=0. Closed cover faces -Y.
assets.placement: Closed maintenance hatch. The dogs are handles, not a locking wheel. No path behind it.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressHoseCoil
assets.origin: Hook above the coil. Coil faces -Y.
assets.placement: One coil on a side wall. Not a second spool family and not a tank.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressColumn
assets.origin: Floor Z=0. 0.50 m shaft, 4.20 m tall.
assets.placement: Far corners only, outside X=1480 and |Y|=1500. Not a pilaster and not a tank.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressHeader
assets.origin: Soffit toward -Y. Seat the top against the wall.
assets.placement: Above the bulkhead opening if the door head needs a separate lintel. Not a roof beam across the room.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressCornerGuard
assets.origin: The angle wraps +X and +Y. Height 1.20 m.
assets.placement: Outside corners of pilasters and the cutaway returns.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressUnistrut
assets.origin: Long axis X. Open side -Y.
assets.placement: Short perimeter support. Do not link copies into a truss across the arena.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressDripTray
assets.origin: Floor Z=0.
assets.placement: Under a pipe joint on the left wall. One or two.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressDownspout
assets.origin: Wall straps on +Y. Outlet turns toward -Y.
assets.placement: Vertical drop at a wall, outlet above the gutter. Not a second pipe rack.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressMeter
assets.origin: Face -Y. Glass is dark.
assets.placement: One gauge on the pipe side. The face stays unlit.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressClamp
assets.origin: Plate on +Y.
assets.placement: Single pipe clamp. Use to break the rhythm of a run.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressEscutcheon
assets.origin: Plate in the Y=0 plane. Pipe read faces -Y.
assets.placement: Where a pipe passes through a panel. The dark cylinder is the penetration, not a hole you can enter.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

assets.name: SM_DressDuctBoot
assets.origin: Flange on +Y, round outlet toward -Y.
assets.placement: A short duct transition. Not another fan and not a ceiling run.
assets.collision: None. Decorative. Keep it outside the combat footprint.

limits: On disk only. Place outside the combat footprint. No collision. Repeat panels and fittings in clusters, with gaps, rather than one continuous stripe.
